page.layout: Two columns of an index of proper names, each entry a Latin form followed by its variant spellings, with a few marginal-style glosses in italic. Left column, then right column. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Mane, Manem vel Manahem. Aut est Mane pro Manem. Cuisimile Iofe pro Iofeph. Hucreferri posset Ionatha. Ejusdem farinæ est Asphane: qui & Asphanes.
Mathusalem, Mathusael, vel si placet Mathusaal.
Michæas, Micha vel Michas vel Micha as.
Nave, Nun. mendum ut apparet, ex Naun. Talia sunt Uz[?], Auz[?]: Hose, Hause: Luz[?], Lauz[?].
Sarra, Sara vel Sarah cum h in fine.
Vastis, Vasthis, vel Vasthi. Græce sine i.

page.notes: The Hebrew-letter forms after "Talia sunt" (Uz, Auz, Luz, Lauz) are printed in a Hebrew-like type and are transcribed only approximately; marked [?]. The Greek "ναβαυ" after Nebo is marked [?]. The first letter of "Sichima" is uncertain. Entries are set in italic in the printed text, so italic is applied throughout. No running head, page number or catchword is printed.
